problems: Applied: 5 satavahana-dynasty findings (Krishna-Guntur coast; Malwa gains via the review's option b; Chhattisgarh until 109 with a new 110 gain from mahameghavahana-dynasty; Nasik at 127; the 124 gain lowered to confidence 1 without Vidarbha) and 5 indo-scythians findings (Arachosia; Ujjain and the -50 Punjab loss; -110 counterpart nobody; -77 split; Sistan war zone). The reviewer-applied note fixes were kept.

Beyond the review: Seistan removed together with Arachosia from the Indo-Scythian 20-74 shapes (133 of the 442 overlapping cells were Sistan); Banavasi added to the Satavahana 184-215 shapes and dissolve on the Chutu dynasty page; Abhira loss moved 199 to 203 (Abhira page 'Established: 203'); new keyframes satavahana-dynasty_110, indo-scythians_-58 and indo-scythians_20.

Disagreement with the review: no dated Kshaharata loss entered for the Satavahana (the only dated sentence, 105-106 CE on the Western Satraps page, names no land and conflicts with the page's own Nahapana dates); Malwa gains not set against kanva-dynasty (option a) because that dossier is thin and untouched.

Residual overlaps outside this repair: satavahana-dynasty and mahameghavahana-dynasty share about 14 cells (3,500 km2) of northern Andhra; mahameghavahana-dynasty's -50 South Kosala gain still overlaps kanva-dynasty's -50..-28 shapes (Chhattisgarh); indo-parthians_14 already holds the core in 19 while indo-scythians loses it at 20. Shunga/Kanva merge question (rename inside one state) is still for the orchestrator.

Mirrors still to be written by their owners: western-satraps (sa-02) for the Satavahana 124, 127, 154, 184 events; kushan-empire (sa-02) for the 51 and 75 losses (the 75 loss no longer includes Kandahar); indo-greeks (me-05) for the -77 (1,607 cells) and -50 (eastern Punjab) events; parthian-empire (me-06) no longer owes a mirror for -110.
